# VibePicks
> Editorial rankings of the best AI tools for vibe coders and builders shipping apps, grouped by use case. Ranks are editorial picks, not paid placements.

Full version with every tool, pricing label, plain-English reason and release: https://vibepicks.ai/llms-full.txt
Each category page also has a plain Markdown copy for AI agents, e.g. https://vibepicks.ai/coding-agents/index.md
New releases as Markdown: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/index.md
Agents can also ask for Markdown directly: request any category page (or the homepage) with the header Accept: text/markdown, e.g. curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://vibepicks.ai/coding-agents/
Last updated: 2026-11-06
Official X account: https://x.com/VibePicksAI (@VibePicksAI). VibePicks launched at vibepicks.ai on 2026-10-15.

## Coding Agents & AI IDEs (https://vibepicks.ai/coding-agents/)
1. [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code): Terminal-based agent for multi-file changes in real repos (Paid)
2. [Cursor](https://cursor.com): AI-first code editor for building and refactoring whole apps (Freemium)
3. [OpenAI Codex](https://chatgpt.com/codex): Delegating coding tasks to a cloud or CLI agent (Freemium)
4. [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot): Inline completions and agent mode inside VS Code and GitHub (Freemium)
5. [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai): Open-source coding agent that works with any AI model (Free)
6. [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google): Google's agent-first coding app and CLI (Freemium)
7. [Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)](https://devin.ai/desktop): Agentic IDE for running and managing local and cloud coding agents (Freemium)
8. [Grok Build](https://x.ai/build): Terminal-based coding agent from xAI (Freemium)

## App Builders (https://vibepicks.ai/app-builders/)
1. [Lovable](https://lovable.dev): Prompt-to-full-stack web app with Supabase integration (Freemium)
2. [Bolt.new](https://bolt.new): In-browser prompt-to-app builds you can run and deploy (Freemium)
3. [v0](https://v0.app): Generating React/Next.js UI and apps from prompts (Freemium)
4. [Replit](https://replit.com): Cloud IDE with an agent that builds and hosts apps (Freemium)

## Deploy & Hosting (https://vibepicks.ai/hosting/)
1. [Vercel](https://vercel.com): Deploying Next.js and frontend apps from Git (Freemium)
2. [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com): Static sites and Jamstack apps with simple deploys (Freemium)
3. [Cloudflare Workers & Pages](https://www.cloudflare.com/products/workers/): Free global hosting for static sites, plus Workers for server code (Freemium)
4. [Railway](https://railway.com): Deploying backends, workers, and databases with little config (Freemium)
5. [Render](https://render.com): Hosting web services, cron jobs, and Postgres (Freemium)

## Auth (https://vibepicks.ai/auth/)
1. [Clerk](https://clerk.com): Drop-in sign-in UI and user management for React/Next.js (Freemium)
2. [Supabase Auth](https://supabase.com/auth): Auth bundled with your Supabase Postgres database (Freemium)
3. [Better Auth](https://better-auth.com): Free, open-source auth that keeps users in your own database (Free)
4. [Auth0](https://auth0.com): Enterprise-grade auth, SSO, and identity (Freemium)
5. [Firebase Authentication](https://firebase.google.com/products/auth): Simple auth for mobile and web apps on Google's stack (Freemium)

## Payments & Email (https://vibepicks.ai/payments-email/)
1. [Stripe](https://stripe.com): Accept card payments, subscriptions and checkout links (Paid)
2. [Resend](https://resend.com): Send emails from your app: receipts, sign-ups, password resets (Freemium)
3. [Paddle](https://www.paddle.com): Sell software and subscriptions with sales tax handled for you (Paid)
4. [Polar](https://polar.sh): Sell digital products, licenses and subscriptions, tax handled (Freemium)
5. [Postmark](https://postmarkapp.com): Reliable transactional email for important messages (Freemium)

## Databases & Backend (https://vibepicks.ai/databases/)
1. [Supabase](https://supabase.com): Postgres, auth, storage, and realtime in one backend (Freemium)
2. [Firebase](https://firebase.google.com): Realtime NoSQL backend for quick mobile/web apps (Freemium)
3. [Neon](https://neon.com): Serverless Postgres with branching (Freemium)
4. [Convex](https://www.convex.dev): Reactive TypeScript backend with built-in database (Freemium)
5. [PlanetScale](https://planetscale.com): Scalable managed MySQL/Postgres (Paid)

## Design-to-Code (https://vibepicks.ai/design-to-code/)
1. [Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/make/): Turning prompts and Figma designs into working prototypes (Freemium)
2. [Builder.io](https://www.builder.io): Converting Figma designs into framework code (Freemium)
3. [Locofy](https://www.locofy.ai): Figma/Penpot to React, Next.js, and mobile code (Paid)
4. [Anima](https://www.animaapp.com): Exporting Figma designs to React/HTML code (Freemium)

## Testing & QA (https://vibepicks.ai/testing/)
1. [Playwright](https://playwright.dev): Reliable end-to-end browser tests (open source) (Free)
2. [Cypress](https://www.cypress.io): Developer-friendly E2E and component testing (Freemium)
3. [Sentry](https://sentry.io): Catching errors and crashes in production (Freemium)

## AI Code Review (https://vibepicks.ai/code-review/)
1. [CodeRabbit](https://www.coderabbit.ai): AI code review on pull requests (Freemium)
2. [Greptile](https://www.greptile.com): AI code review that understands your whole codebase (Freemium)
3. [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot): Automatic AI review on GitHub pull requests (Paid)

## LLM APIs (https://vibepicks.ai/llm-apis/)
1. [OpenAI API](https://platform.openai.com): General-purpose GPT models for chat, tools, and vision (Paid)
2. [Anthropic API](https://claude.com/platform/api): Claude models, strong at coding and long context (Paid)
3. [Google Gemini API](https://ai.google.dev): Gemini models with large context and multimodal input (Freemium)
4. [xAI API](https://x.ai/api): Grok models plus image, video and voice on one API key (Paid)
5. [DeepSeek API](https://api-docs.deepseek.com): Low-cost models with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs (Paid)
6. [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai): One API key to route across many model providers (Freemium)

## AI Images & Art (https://vibepicks.ai/ai-images/)
1. [ChatGPT Images](https://chatgpt.com/images): Quick images and edits by chatting (Freemium)
2. [Nano Banana (Gemini)](https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/): Make and edit images by chatting in the Gemini app (Freemium)
3. [Midjourney](https://www.midjourney.com): High-quality illustrations and artistic images (Paid)
4. [FLUX (Black Forest Labs)](https://bfl.ai): Photo-real images and an image API with open models (Paid)
5. [Ideogram](https://ideogram.ai): Logos, stickers, posters and images with readable text (Freemium)
6. [Grok Imagine](https://grok.com/imagine): Quick images from a sentence, right inside Grok (Freemium)
7. [Recraft](https://www.recraft.ai): Logos, icons, vector art and brand sets (Freemium)
8. [Leonardo](https://leonardo.ai): Emotes, game assets, characters and stylized art (Freemium)

## AI Audio & Voice (https://vibepicks.ai/ai-audio/)

3. [Descript](https://www.descript.com): Edit podcasts and videos by editing the transcript (Freemium)

## AI for Hardware & Electronics (https://vibepicks.ai/ai-hardware/)
1. [Arduino Cloud](https://cloud.arduino.cc): Write, upload and control Arduino/ESP32 projects with a built-in AI assistant (Freemium)
2. [Wokwi](https://wokwi.com): Simulate Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico projects in your browser (Freemium)
3. [Tinkercad](https://www.tinkercad.com): Beginner circuits and 3D-printable designs (Free)
4. [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com): Explain wiring, write firmware and troubleshoot step by step (Freemium)
5. [Flux](https://www.flux.ai): AI-assisted circuit and PCB design (Paid)
6. [OpenPLC](https://autonomylogic.com): Free, open-source PLC you can program with ladder logic (Free)

## Recent releases
- 2026-11-06: OpenRouter — OpenRouter rebuilt its Auto Router and added Auto Code (openrouter/auto-code), a router tuned for coding harnesses that picks a model per request; OpenRouter says it scores in line with Claude Opus 5.5 at 74% lower cost per task (source: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/auto-and-auto-code-routers/; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-06-openrouter-7d74b3)
- 2026-11-06: GitHub Copilot — @GitHub in Slack and Microsoft Teams is generally available: investigate bugs, create issues and open pull requests from a chat, with Canvas in Teams for reviewing plans, diffs and previews alongside the conversation (source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-06-github-copilot-in-slack-and-teams-is-generally-available/; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-06-github-copilot-0c711d)
- 2026-11-06: Vercel Tracing — Vercel Tracing is generally available on all plans: a new Traces page with KQL search, vercel traces search in the CLI, tracing on by default for new Next.js 16.5 projects, and longer retention (3 days Hobby, 14 days Pro) (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/vercel-tracing-is-now-generally-available; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-06-vercel-tracing-a18dce)
- 2026-11-06: Replit Agent — Replit Agent can now troubleshoot platform problems in chat by checking incidents, docs and known issues, and on Pro it files the support ticket for you with debugging details attached (source: https://docs.replit.com/updates; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-06-replit-agent-cb1347)
- 2026-11-05: Codex CLI (OpenAI) — Codex CLI 0.167.0 opens an agent command center with codex agents --no-daemon, marks unread results, lets you switch backends without losing drafts, and adds a Google Cloud Vertex AI setup wizard (source: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.167.0; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-codex-cli-openai-9dbd89)
- 2026-11-05: Cursor — Cursor can now build live apps and share them with a link: describe the tool you want, and Cursor scaffolds the web app, sets up a Postgres database and auth behind Cursor SSO when needed, runs deterministic and agentic security checks, and deploys to a URL you pick. Available on all paid plans with cloud agents enabled (source: https://cursor.com/changelog/build-live-apps; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-cursor-5a911b)
- 2026-11-05: Kiro — Kiro bots are generally available in Kiro Crew: named, long-running agents with their own memory, notes, tools and permissions that coordinate parallel worker sessions, keep a single ongoing chat for direction and results, and can run on schedules for recurring work like issue triage, build monitoring or release readiness (source: https://kiro.dev/blog/crew-bots/; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-kiro-479fb4)
- 2026-11-05: Evergreen — Carta released Evergreen for other companies: a multiplayer cloud coding platform where teammates and agents share sessions, agents push PRs on their own, and it runs on Claude, Codex, Grok and Muse with isolated sessions, scoped access, audit logs and spending caps. 7-day free trial (source: https://evergreen.carta.com/blog/introducing-evergreen; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-evergreen-e0aa49)
- 2026-11-05: Vercel Schedules — Vercel Schedules is in public beta on all plans: define recurring or one-time schedules in vercel.json or at runtime that target a private Function, HTTP path or Queue topic, enable/disable/run on demand without redeploying. Successor to Cron Jobs; Hobby includes 5,000 runs/month, Pro/Enterprise from $5 per 1M runs (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/vercel-schedules-is-now-in-public-beta; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-vercel-schedules-b84eb9)
- 2026-11-05: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash — Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is on Vercel AI Gateway as google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash: generate 3–15 second videos with native audio from text (or edit source clips with up to six reference images) via one API key with no separate Google account, using generateText or streamText in the AI SDK (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/gemini-omni-1-2-flash-now-available-on-ai-gateway; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-gemini-omni-1-2-flash-ac7108)
- 2026-11-05: Kimi Hosted Agents — Moonshot AI launched Kimi Hosted Agents, a managed Harness-as-a-Service for long-running and multi-agent workloads: isolated cloud sandboxes, network controls, stoppable sessions, audit logs, 140+ Skills and 30+ plugins, plus finance Agent templates. Sign up at platform.kimi.com; usage-based pricing (sandbox-hours plus model tokens and plugin calls) (source: https://www.kimi.com/news/kimi-hosted-agents; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-05-kimi-hosted-agents-f553f8)
- 2026-11-04: Devin — Cognition released SWE-2 Flash, a smaller coding model (276B total, 12B active parameters) that runs at about 200 tokens a second, 3x faster than SWE-2 at one-fifth the price, and scores 89.9 on SWE-Bench Pro v2 Hard against SWE-2's 90.6. It's available now in Devin Desktop and the Devin CLI; weights aren't public yet, only through a planned partner program (source: https://cognition.com/blog/swe-2-flash; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-04-devin-f92b2d)
- 2026-11-04: Atlassian Code Reviewer — Atlassian Code Reviewer is generally available with paid Jira and Teamwork Collection plans: an AI agent that reviews pull requests in Bitbucket Cloud and GitHub (GitLab coming), leaves inline comments with fixes you can apply, and checks each PR against the acceptance criteria in its linked Jira work item. It starts in manual mode (reviews only when the author asks) and uses Rovo credits (source: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/development/code-reviewer; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-04-atlassian-code-reviewer-5f9ccf)
- 2026-11-04: GitHub Copilot — GitHub Copilot now works inside Xcode's built-in coding assistant, in public preview from Xcode 27.3 beta on macOS Tahoe 26.6 or later. Turn it on in Xcode > Settings > Intelligence; every Copilot plan is supported, and the separate Copilot for Xcode extension still works (source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-04-github-copilot-is-now-available-in-xcodes-coding-assistant/; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-04-github-copilot-16211c)
- 2026-11-04: Lovable — Lovable now runs "Dreaming" on paid plans: in the background it checks its project memory and your AGENTS.md rules against your code and chat, then rewrites or removes notes that no longer apply, while keeping rules you asked for. It never touches your app's code, shows AGENTS.md edits in chat and version history, and uses no credits (source: https://docs.lovable.dev/changelog; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-04-lovable-2719b5)
- 2026-11-03: Claude Code — Claude Code 2.1.318 shows when your stored claude.ai sign-in expires (claude auth status and claude -p JSON) and warns in claude -p output 10 days before it ends, lets a mod's side job run at low effort, and fixes --continue losing earlier conversation, macOS sessions stalling with many Bash commands, and keys typed right after sending a message answering permission prompts. It also stops auto-installing the IDE extension from IDE terminals (source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.318; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-claude-code-d95d5e)
- 2026-11-03: Vercel Security Review — Vercel Security Review is in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams: every push to a connected GitHub repo (including direct pushes to production) gets an AI scan of the changed code for issues like missing auth checks or exposed secrets, with findings in a Vulnerabilities dashboard, a GitHub check and PR comments. Vercel Agent can open a fix PR, or pull findings into your own coding agent with vercel security vulnerabilities. Reviews are free until Nov 10, 2026, then billed at the Vercel Agent token rate (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/vercel-security-review-public-beta; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-vercel-security-review-d287f5)
- 2026-11-03: Vercel CLI — vercel doctor checks your Vercel CLI version and install, login, team, project link and vercel.json, reports Vercel status incidents, and prints the exact command that fixes each problem. It never prompts or logs in, and --json gives structured output, so coding agents can run it before guessing at a fix (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/vercel-cli-now-diagnoses-setup-problems-with-vercel-doctor; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-vercel-cli-07c26f)
- 2026-11-03: Tencent Hy4 — Tencent's Hy4, the first Hy model with vision and computer use, is on Vercel AI Gateway as tencent/hy4 at 50% off through Dec 31, 2026 (about $0.42 in / $1.25 out per million tokens): 1M-token context, tool calling, structured outputs and image input, and usable from Claude Code, Codex or Cursor via the gateway (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/tencent-hy4-now-available-on-ai-gateway; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-tencent-hy4-e143aa)
- 2026-11-03: GitHub Copilot — GitHub Copilot now works inside JetBrains Air: pick Copilot in Air's agent picker to delegate tasks on your existing Copilot subscription, track several agent sessions in parallel and review changes next to your code, or run cloud tasks in isolated containers through Air Teams billed to your Copilot plan rather than JetBrains AI credits (source: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-03-github-copilot-is-now-available-in-jetbrains-air/; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-github-copilot-4204c1)
- 2026-11-03: Replit Agent — Replit Agent now works in Slack: mention @Replit in a channel or DM to build a prototype, work on an existing project, ask questions about your codebase or pull data from connected tools like Linear and Notion; each thread is its own Replit chat and uses the linked user's own permissions (source: https://x.com/Replit/status/2117689305019887899; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-replit-agent-3c507f)
- 2026-11-03: Bolt — Bolt for Microsoft Teams is live on the Microsoft Marketplace: describe what you want inside Teams or Copilot, get a build plan, and ship the app without leaving the chat (source: https://x.com/boltdotnew/status/2117648022737682467; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-03-bolt-df99ea)
- 2026-11-02: Claude Code — Claude Code 2.1.317 now asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address out, warns when a new /schedule cloud task picks up connectors you did not ask for, and lets Agent SDK hooks use onFailure: "block" so a failing check stops the action instead of letting it run. It also fixes project MCP servers dropping after the first turn in some desktop sessions and claude auth status signing you out after a slow token refresh (source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.317; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-claude-code-3b1a4a)
- 2026-11-02: Vercel — Vercel now blocks known-malicious npm package versions before and during dependency installs on every plan, with no setup: it checks your lockfile (including cached dependencies) and stops bad downloads, so a poisoned install script can't run in your build. If one is found the deploy fails and names the package and version; bump it, update the lockfile and redeploy (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/blocking-malicious-npm-packages-before-and-during-installation; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-vercel-694c0b)
- 2026-11-02: Vercel — Projects can now be configured with vercel.toml, which takes every setting vercel.json does but allows comments and has a flatter layout. Use only one config file per project: vercel.toml, vercel.json or vercel.ts (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/projects-can-now-be-configured-with-vercel-toml; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-vercel-f9ed10)
- 2026-11-02: Vercel MCP — Vercel MCP now shows your deployments as a live card inside ChatGPT and other chat apps that support MCP Apps, with build status, build logs, commit details and a Visit button, so you can paste logs into the chat and debug a failed deploy with the model without opening the dashboard (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/monitor-vercel-deployments-in-chatgpt; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-vercel-mcp-7bf9d1)
- 2026-11-02: LongCat 2.5 (Meituan) — Meituan's LongCat 2.5, a model built for coding agents and image-based programming with a 1M-token context and text plus image input, is now on Vercel AI Gateway as meituan/longcat-2.5, so you can try it in Claude Code, Codex or Cursor through one AI Gateway key without opening a Meituan account (source: https://vercel.com/changelog/longcat-2-5-now-available-on-ai-gateway; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-longcat-2-5-meituan-1234aa)
- 2026-11-02: Supabase CLI — Supabase CLI v3.0.0 is a major release: commands like db push, db pull, gen types and storage now target your local stack by default, one --remote flag replaces --linked, --project-ref and --db-url, and every change to a hosted project asks for confirmation, with No as the default answer (pass --yes in CI or agent runs). Read the v2 to v3 migration guide before upgrading scripts. It also points to the experimental local stack that gives each project, git worktree or agent its own local Supabase, with or without Docker (source: https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/tag/v3.0.0; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-11-02-supabase-cli-b33c72)
- 2026-10-31: DeepSeek dsh-superagent — DeepSeek open-sourced dsh-superagent (MIT), a research prototype of a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository: when an allowed person asks for work in an issue thread (or optionally Feishu), it opens a work item, does the job in its own session and directory and answers back, often with a pull request, plus a web panel for what needs a human. It runs as a DeepSeek Harness bundle; DeepSeek says it is not an official product, so try it on a side repo (source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype; VibePicks entry: https://vibepicks.ai/releases/#r-2026-10-31-deepseek-dsh-superagent-ff80cc)
- 2026-10-30: Claude Code — v2.1.316 adds CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT, so subagents that only search and read files can run at a lower effort level than your main session instead of inheriting it, plus CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK to turn the ultrathink keyword off.
